datasets.name: Arecanut Disease Detection Dataset - 6 Classes

HEALTHY LEAF.description: Normal, deep green arecanut frond with intact pinnae and uniform photosynthetic surface.
HEALTHY LEAF.management: Apply recommended NPK (100:40:140 g/palm/year) in split doses with 12 kg green manure.

HEALTHY NUT.description: Normal, well-developed green arecanut bunches with firm calyx attachment and no fungal rotting.
HEALTHY NUT.management: Continue seasonal drip irrigation (15-20 L/palm/day) and prophylactic pre-monsoon sprays.

BUD ROT.symptoms: Yellowing and rotting of the central spindle leaf; inner tissues disintegrate emitting a foul smell; crown rots and topples in advanced stages.
BUD ROT.treatment: Remove infected spindle and rotting tissues; apply Bordeaux paste to the cut surface. Spray 1% Bordeaux mixture or Metalaxyl MZ 72 WP @ 2g/L to surrounding crowns as prophylactic.

KOLEROGA.symptoms: Water-soaked dark green lesions near calyx of immature nuts; nuts rot and shed in large numbers; whitish mycelial growth covers shed nuts during heavy monsoon.
KOLEROGA.treatment: Prophylactic spraying of 1% Bordeaux mixture (with rosin soap adhesive @ 500g/100L) before South-West monsoon onset; repeat after 40-45 days. Collect and destroy shed infected nuts.

RING SPOT.symptoms: Concentric chlorotic rings with necrotic brown centers on leaf pinnae; premature leaf drying.
RING SPOT.treatment: Spray Mancozeb 75 WP @ 2g/L or Carbendazim 50 WP @ 1g/L at initial symptom appearance.

YELLOW LEAF.causal_organism: Arecanut Yellow Leaf Phytoplasma (transmitted by Proutista moesta / plant hopper)
YELLOW LEAF.symptoms: Conspicuous yellowing of inner whorl leaves spreading to outer leaves; blackening of kernel with spongy texture; gradual reduction in crown size and yield.
YELLOW LEAF.treatment: No chemical cure for phytoplasma. Improve drainage, apply additional 100g MgSO4 + 500g lime/palm/year, maintain balanced nutrition (UAS Shivamogga protocol), and rogue severely debilitated palms.

karnataka_general_plantvillage_alignment.applicability: General deep learning model for Solanaceous and Horticultural crops (Tomato, Potato, Pepper/Chilli, Maize), cross-referenced with UAS Bangalore / UAS Dharwad extension guidelines.
karnataka_general_plantvillage_alignment.transparency_note: PlantVillage is an open-access general plant disease dataset and does not originate specifically from Karnataka. Inferences are validated against Karnataka State Agricultural University bulletins.
